newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle brisk at $106/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle brisk at $106/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active on Tuesday morning, USDA said. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers live basis mostly $1.00 per cwt higher than Monday, dressed basis firm to $1.00 higher. Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest good at the higher bids.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 65.00, few 66.00 delivered, few 64.00-64.50; Dressed basis - 105.00-105.50, some to 106.00. ( weighted average 105.26 ).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 65.00, few 64.00-64.50; Dressed basis - 105.00-105.50, few 106.00, few 104.00-104.50. ( weighted average 105.25 ). Confirmed - 40,100 Last Week - 34,100 Last Year - 6,200 Wk To Date- 65,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 54,383 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 9,200
